title: The headless migration agent costs 4x: prompt caching never hits
area: AI integration: context engineering and caching
scenario: The pod's migration agent runs headless in CI with a large cached system prompt. FinOps flagged spend at 4x since 2026-11-05 with flat job counts; the dashboard shows zero cache reads, and a developer blames the model bump that shipped the same day.
task: Find every source of cached-prefix instability, including cross-process ones
Rule the model bump in or out with evidence
Fix build_request: stable prefix, time after the breakpoint
Propose the CI guard that would have caught it
acceptance: Prefix identical across time, listing order and skill order
Time still reaches the model after the breakpoint; modules do not share a prefix
Replay reads the cache after turn one and costs far less
ANSWER.md explains the mechanisms with evidence
